concepts.gloss_en: The strap(s) of tefillin — the encompassing lights of Malkhut/faith (emunah) and the aspect of yirah (fear)

reason_for_human: All 7 occurrences (רְצוּעוֹת plural, רְצוּעָה singular, הָרְצוּעָה definite) are the same word for the tefillin strap; every context ties it explicitly to רצועה של תפלין and its symbolism as encompassing lights of Malkhut/emunah and as yirah. Singular/plural and definite/indefinite are mere inflection of one concept — the article here just means 'the strap' in the ma'abarta discussion, not an archetype vs. generic split. Round-1 grouping stands.
